title_en: llm-gemini 0.37
title_zh: llm-gemini 0.37
summary_en: Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, the lowest-cost model in the Gemini 4 family, priced at $1.50 per million input tokens, $0.075 cached input, and $7.50 output. Carbon and Argon are priced identically at $2.00/$0.10/$10.00 until November 30, 2026, then double to $4.00/$0.20/$20.00; Argon offers faster responses and lower token spend per turn. Hydrogen is only 25% cheaper than its peers initially, but after December 1 it becomes 75% cheaper; still, it is 15x more expensive than Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna ($0.10/$0.50). Hydrogen is the new free tier model and will power AI features in Google Search.
summary_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，是 Gemini 4 系列中成本最低的模型，定价为每百万输入 token $1.50、缓存输入 $0.075、输出 $7.50。Carbon 和 Argon 定价相同，在 2026 年 11 月 30 日前为 $2.00/$0.10/$10.00，之后翻倍至 $4.00/$0.20/$20.00；Argon 响应更快且每轮 token 消耗更低。Hydrogen 初期仅比同系列模型便宜 25%，但 12 月 1 日后将便宜 75%；不过它仍比 Claude Haiku 5.5 和 GPT-6 Luna（$0.10/$0.50）贵 15 倍。Hydrogen 是新的免费层级模型，并将为 Google 搜索的 AI 功能提供支持。

title_en: Liquid AI Releases LiquidCodec, a 74M-Parameter Streaming Audio Codec
title_zh: Liquid AI 发布 LiquidCodec：74M 参数流式音频编解码器
summary_en: Liquid AI released LiquidCodec, a ~74M-parameter streaming speech tokenizer used in its LFM3-Audio-2B and LFM3-Omni-2B models. It compresses 24 kHz audio into 12 token streams at 12.5 Hz using grouped finite scalar quantization (GFSQ) instead of RVQ, enabling parallel prediction. On a single CPU thread, it achieves ~361x real-time encoding and ~87x decoding, with encode RTF 0.0028 vs Mimi's 0.0361. It outperforms X-Codec 2, NanoCodec, and Mimi on ViSQOL and mel distance across 8 test sets, and achieves the highest TTS UTMOSv2, though NanoCodec leads on PESQ (WB) in 7 of 8 sets.
summary_zh: Liquid AI 发布了 LiquidCodec，一个约 7400 万参数的流式语音分词器，用于其 LFM3-Audio-2B 和 LFM3-Omni-2B 模型。它采用分组有限标量量化（GFSQ）而非 RVQ，将 24 kHz 音频压缩为 12 个 token 流（12.5 Hz 帧率），支持并行预测。在单 CPU 线程上，编码速度达约 361 倍实时，解码约 87 倍实时，编码 RTF 为 0.0028（Mimi 为 0.0361）。在 8 个测试集上，其 ViSQOL 和 mel 距离均优于 X-Codec 2、NanoCodec 和 Mimi，TTS UTMOSv2 得分最高，但 NanoCodec 在 8 个测试集中的 7 个上 PESQ (WB) 更高。

title_en: Google’s new Gemini model is better at understanding complicated questions
title_zh: Google 新 Gemini 模型更擅长理解复杂问题
summary_en: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a new model that better handles complex questions by breaking them down and addressing each part, including multi-part queries, typos, and specific requests. It is available in Search, the Gemini app, Google AI Studio, Gemini API, and other services, and is now the default model in AI Mode. The model provides more links via simultaneous queries across subtopics, richer visuals like images and tables, and improved language understanding. It offers thinking levels low, medium, high, and a new 'xhigh' mode, and Google claims it delivers significant leaps in speed and intelligence over Gemini Flash 3.8, matching or outperforming competitors like Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Terra.
summary_zh: Google 发布了 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 模型，能更好地处理复杂问题，通过分解问题并逐一回答，包括多部分查询、拼写错误和高度具体的请求。该模型已在搜索、Gemini 应用、Google AI Studio、Gemini API 等服务中上线，并成为 AI 模式的默认模型。它通过同时查询相关子主题提供更广泛的链接，并增加图像、对比表格、图表和地图等视觉内容，同时改进了所有支持语言的理解能力。模型提供低、中、高和新的“xhigh”思考级别，Google 称其在速度和智能上相比 Gemini Flash 3.8 有显著提升，并能匹配或超越 Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 GPT-6.1 Terra 等竞品。

title_en: LLMON: An LLM-Native Markup Language, now in Granite 4.1 3B and 8B
title_zh: LLMON：LLM原生标记语言，现已登陆Granite 4.1 3B和8B
summary_en: IBM Research released LLMON (LLM Object Notation), an XML-like markup language that uses reserved special tokens to explicitly mark structure and semantics in LLM context. Two experimental preview models, granite-4.1-3b-LLMON-preview and granite-4.1-8b-LLMON-preview, were trained from Granite 4.1 base checkpoints to consume and generate LLMON. On the OPI benchmark, LLMON models avoid 47% more indirect prompt injection attacks than the best frontier model and 95% more than the best open-source model, while maintaining general capability on par with Granite 4.1 Instruct. The models use a chat template that renders named parts (instruction, data, requirement) into addressable blocks bound by an exec block, and a LoRA can be tuned for custom vocabularies.
summary_zh: IBM Research 发布了 LLMON（LLM Object Notation），一种类似 XML 的标记语言，使用保留的特殊 token 显式标记 LLM 上下文中的结构和语义。两个实验性预览模型 granite-4.1-3b-LLMON-preview 和 granite-4.1-8b-LLMON-preview 基于 Granite 4.1 基础检查点训练，能够消费和生成 LLMON。在 OPI 基准上，LLMON 模型比最佳前沿模型多避免 47% 的间接提示注入攻击，比最佳开源模型多避免 95%，同时通用能力与 Granite 4.1 Instruct 持平。模型使用聊天模板将命名部分（指令、数据、要求）渲染为可寻址块，并由 exec 块绑定，还可通过 LoRA 微调自定义词汇表。

title_en: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
title_zh: 推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen
summary_en: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast and efficient model for everyday coding and agentic workflows, available across all tiers of Google AI Studio, Gemini API, Gemini app, and Search. It surpasses Gemini 4 Argon on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (51 vs. 50 at default high thinking, up to 54 at xhigh) and is priced at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens for its 1M-token context window. Hydrogen finishes tasks 2.5x faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash and more than triples Terminal-Bench 4.1 scores (57% vs. 18.2%). It introduces four thinking levels (low, medium, high, xhigh) and pairs with Carbon and Argon in multi-model workflows via Orchestrator, which achieves near-Carbon success rates with 24% less quota and 19% faster completion on Terminal-Bench 4.0.
summary_zh: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，一款面向日常编码和智能体工作流的高效快速模型，已在 Google AI Studio、Gemini API、Gemini 应用和搜索等全平台上线。在默认高思考级别下，其 Artificial Analysis 智能指数超过 Gemini 4 Argon（51 对 50，最高 xhigh 级别达 54），100 万 token 上下文窗口统一定价为每百万输入 token 1.50 美元、每百万输出 token 7.50 美元。相比 Gemini 3.8 Flash，Hydrogen 完成任务速度提升 2.5 倍，Terminal-Bench 4.1 得分提高两倍以上（57% 对 18.2%）。它提供四个思考级别（低、中、高、xhigh），并通过 Google Antigravity 中的 Orchestrator 与 Carbon、Argon 协同，在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上以平均减少 24% 配额消耗和加快 19% 的速度达到接近 Carbon 的任务成功率。

title_en: AWS Releases AWS Emulator: A Local Copy of 200+ AWS Services Built by AI Agents
title_zh: AWS 发布 AWS Emulator：由 AI 代理构建的 200+ AWS 服务本地副本
summary_en: AWS has released AWS Emulator, a local emulator of AWS APIs that runs on laptops, dev servers, or CI without requiring an AWS account. It was built from 438 AWS API models covering 200+ services, with all code written and reviewed by autonomous AI agents. In release v1.0.322, it passes 24,243 of 42,857 scored fidelity tests (56.6%), with AWS KMS at 93.9% and Amazon SQS at 89.8%, but AWS CloudFormation at only 15.8%. The emulator is free under CC0 license, runs in-memory, and is best for fast local testing, though it lacks IAM evaluation and multi-region support.
summary_zh: AWS 发布了 AWS Emulator，这是一个本地 AWS API 模拟器，可在笔记本电脑、开发服务器或 CI 环境中运行，无需 AWS 账户。它基于 438 个 AWS API 模型构建，覆盖 200+ 服务，所有代码均由自主 AI 代理编写和审查。在 v1.0.322 版本中，它通过了 42,857 个评分保真度测试中的 24,243 个（56.6%），其中 AWS KMS 达 93.9%，Amazon SQS 达 89.8%，但 AWS CloudFormation 仅 15.8%。该模拟器以 CC0 许可证免费提供，资源存储在内存中，最适合快速本地测试，但不支持 IAM 评估和多区域。

title_en: Gemini Decisions API
title_zh: Gemini Decisions API 发布
summary_en: Google has launched the Gemini Decisions API with its "Gemini Decision 1" model, entering the decision model category alongside Jev and OpenAI. The API supports yes/no, choice, and rubric-scoring questions, similar to Jev, and is priced at 10 cents per million input tokens with free output. Unlike Jev (text/JSON only) and OpenAI (text and images), Gemini Decision 1 is fully multimodal, handling text, images, audio, video, and PDFs. In a test with a video, it returned probabilistic yes/no answers (e.g., 0.923 for robot presence) instead of binary 1.0/0.0.
summary_zh: Google 推出了 Gemini Decisions API，包含“Gemini Decision 1”模型，加入 Jev 和 OpenAI 所在的决策模型类别。该 API 支持是/否、选择和评分标准打分三种问题类型，与 Jev 类似，定价为每百万输入 token 10 美分，输出免费。与仅支持文本/JSON 的 Jev 和支持文本与图像的 OpenAI 不同，Gemini Decision 1 完全多模态，可处理文本、图像、音频、视频和 PDF。在视频测试中，它返回概率性的是/否答案（例如机器人存在的概率为 0.923），而非二元的 1.0/0.0。

title_en: Google Launches Gemini Decisions API With Gemini Decision 1 at $0.10/M Tokens
title_zh: Google 发布 Gemini Decisions API 与 Gemini Decision 1，定价 $0.10/百万 tokens
summary_en: Google launched the Gemini Decisions API powered by Gemini Decision 1, a specialized multimodal model that scores up to 1,000 typed questions against a shared input and returns calibrated probabilities without generating text. It supports yes/no, multiple-choice, and rubric scoring question types, with a 262,144-token context and 150-250 ms end-to-end latency. On Google's benchmarks, it leads 7 of 9 accuracy tests, achieves 92.2% on JevBench and the lowest calibration error (0.0250 ECE), but trails TypeSafe Jev 1.14 on When2Call (79.9% vs 82.0%) and costs more per token ($0.10 vs $0.042). Priced at $0.10 per 1M input tokens with zero output token billing, it is available via the Gemini Developer API (v1beta).
summary_zh: Google 发布了由 Gemini Decision 1 驱动的 Gemini Decisions API，该专用多模态模型不生成文本，而是针对共享输入对最多 1,000 个结构化问题打分并返回校准概率。它支持是/否、多选和评分三种问题类型，上下文长度为 262,144 tokens，端到端延迟 150-250 毫秒。在 Google 的基准测试中，它在 9 项准确率测试中领先 7 项，JevBench 达到 92.2%，校准误差最低（ECE 0.0250），但在 When2Call 上落后于 TypeSafe Jev 1.14（79.9% vs 82.0%），且每 token 成本更高（$0.10 vs $0.042）。定价为每百万输入 tokens $0.10，输出 tokens 不计费，可通过 Gemini Developer API（v1beta）使用。

title_en: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
title_zh: AlphaGenome 2：解读细胞如何读取DNA以深入理解疾病
summary_en: AlphaGenome 2 is a next-generation DNA sequence model that predicts how genetic variants affect specific human cell types by conditioning on cell type or state. Trained on over 107 million individual cell profiles across 68 tissues, it identifies nearly twice as many expression-changing variants as the previous model (30% vs. 16% causal variant recall on TenK10K). The model supports cross-modality imputation and generalizes to unseen cell states without retraining, enabling disease-relevant predictions such as the IBD-associated ETS2 variant in gut macrophages. It is available for non-commercial research via the AlphaGenome API and in private preview for commercial use.
summary_zh: AlphaGenome 2 是新一代DNA序列模型，通过以细胞类型或状态为条件，预测遗传变异如何影响特定人类细胞类型。该模型在68种组织的超过1.07亿个单细胞图谱上训练，在TenK10K数据集上识别出的因果变异数量几乎是先前模型的两倍（30% vs. 16%）。它支持跨模态插补，并能泛化到未见过的细胞状态而无需重新训练，从而实现对疾病相关变异的预测，例如肠道巨噬细胞中与IBD相关的ETS2变异。该模型已通过AlphaGenome API面向非商业研究开放，商业研究可申请私有预览。

title_en: Google’s AlphaGenome 2 zooms in on the cellular roots of disease
title_zh: Google AlphaGenome 2 聚焦疾病细胞根源
summary_en: Google DeepMind has released AlphaGenome 2, an AI model that predicts how genetic variants affect individual cell types and states. Trained on over 100 million cell profiles across 68 tissues, it identifies nearly twice as many variants affecting gene expression as its predecessor, AlphaGenome. The model can generalize to new cell types without retraining and helps identify gaps in experimental data. It is available for non-commercial research via the AlphaGenome API, with a private preview for commercial use.
summary_zh: Google DeepMind 发布了 AlphaGenome 2，这是一个能够预测遗传变异如何影响个体细胞类型和状态的 AI 模型。该模型在 68 种组织的超过 1 亿个细胞图谱上训练，识别出的影响基因表达的变异数量几乎是前代 AlphaGenome 的两倍。它无需重新训练即可泛化到新的细胞类型，并有助于发现实验数据中的空白。该模型通过 AlphaGenome API 供非商业研究使用，商业研究可申请有限私有预览。

title_en: MBZUAI’s IFM Releases PAN 2, an Open 29B World Model for Physical AI
title_zh: MBZUAI的IFM发布PAN 2：一个开放的29B物理AI世界模型
summary_en: MBZUAI's Institute of Foundation Models (IFM) released PAN 2, an open 29B-parameter world model for physical AI that simulates scene outcomes from text actions as video. It uses a two-stage architecture: an LLM planner (e.g., Kimi K3) generates structured JSON world states, and a 29B MMDiT diffusion transformer predicts video latents, conditioned by a frozen Qwen3.5-9B encoder. PAN 2 leads 6 tested models on full-plan completion (34.0% vs 32.5% for MiniMax-H3) but trails on single actions and human preference (Elo 1595 vs 1620). Weights, training and inference code are Apache 2.0; it runs on data-center GPUs with each worker holding the full model in BF16.
summary_zh: MBZUAI的基础模型研究所（IFM）发布了PAN 2，一个开放的29B参数物理AI世界模型，可根据文本动作将场景变化模拟为视频。它采用两阶段架构：LLM规划器（如Kimi K3）生成结构化JSON世界状态，29B的MMDiT扩散Transformer预测视频潜变量，并由冻结的Qwen3.5-9B编码器条件化。PAN 2在6个测试模型的全计划完成率上领先（34.0% vs MiniMax-H3的32.5%），但在单动作和人类偏好上落后（Elo 1595 vs 1620）。权重、训练和推理代码均以Apache 2.0发布；运行于数据中心GPU，每个工作节点以BF16加载完整模型。

title_en: BotPsy: On-Device Personal Assistant with a Sub-Billion-Parameter Agentic Language Model
title_zh: BotPsy：基于亚十亿参数智能体语言模型的端侧个人助理
summary_en: Tether AI Research released BotPsy, a 0.8B-parameter model built on Qwen3.5-0.8B for on-device function calling and agentic workflows. It is post-trained in four stages: SFT, Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD), and two rounds of RL with DAPO, using rule-based rewards with fine-grained partial credit for tool calls. BotPsy roughly doubles its base model's agentic performance (BFCL v4 23.4→44.0, ACEBench 30.1→58.7, τ-bench 23.2→51.5) and outperforms all tested models up to 1.2B parameters, even beating Qwen3.5-2B-Think on five of six benchmarks. It also improves instruction following (IFEval 59.7→90.8, IFBench 22.0→55.9), reduces unsafe responses from 36% to 21%, and cuts reasoning tokens by about 3×. Released under Apache 2.0 in bf16, Q8, and Q4 formats.
summary_zh: Tether AI Research 发布了 BotPsy，一个基于 Qwen3.5-0.8B 构建的 0.8B 参数模型，专为端侧函数调用和智能体工作流设计。它经过四阶段后训练：SFT、多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）以及两轮基于 DAPO 的强化学习，采用基于规则的奖励并对工具调用给予细粒度部分分。BotPsy 的智能体性能约为基座模型的两倍（BFCL v4 从 23.4 升至 44.0，ACEBench 从 30.1 升至 58.7，τ-bench 从 23.2 升至 51.5），在测试的所有 ≤1.2B 参数模型中表现最佳，甚至在六项基准中的五项上超越 Qwen3.5-2B-Think。它还提升了指令遵循能力（IFEval 从 59.7 升至 90.8，IFBench 从 22.0 升至 55.9），将不安全响应率从 36% 降至 21%，并将推理 token 数减少约 3 倍。模型以 Apache 2.0 许可证发布，提供 bf16、Q8 和 Q4 三种精度。

title_en: Fish Audio Releases Live 3, a Full-Duplex Voice Model That Reacts in 186 ms
title_zh: Fish Audio 发布 Live 3 全双工语音模型，反应时间低至 186 毫秒
summary_en: Fish Audio released Live 3, a full-duplex voice model for real-time voice agents that listens while speaking, enabling natural turn-taking without breaking calls. It moves conversational timing from hand-tuned pipeline rules into the speech model, trained on real human conversations to learn when to acknowledge, wait, respond, or stop. The model can decide to respond in as little as 186 ms for short reactions like 'mm-hmm', though full answer latency is not disclosed. Live 3 is available on the Fish Agent Platform, Fish Audio API, and on-premises, priced at $0.035 per minute (promotional until Dec 31, 2026, then $0.07), with English-only support and no published benchmark scores.
summary_zh: Fish Audio 发布了 Live 3 全双工语音模型，专为实时语音代理设计，可在说话的同时保持聆听，实现自然的对话轮次切换。该模型将对话时序从手工调优的流水线规则转移到语音模型中，基于真实人类对话训练，学习何时确认、等待、回应或停止。对于“嗯哼”等简短反应，模型可在低至 186 毫秒内决定回应，但完整回复的延迟未公开。Live 3 已在 Fish Agent Platform、Fish Audio API 及企业本地部署中提供，促销价为每分钟 0.035 美元（至 2026 年 12 月 31 日，之后为 0.07 美元），目前仅支持英语，且未发布基准测试分数。

title_en: Meta FAIR Releases e-means: An Algorithm Beating k-means in 10x Fewer Epochs
title_zh: Meta FAIR 发布 e-means：用 1/10 的 epoch 击败 k-means 的聚类算法
summary_en: Meta FAIR released e-means, a mini-batch k-means algorithm that updates centroids using exponential moving averages (EMA), available in FAISS 1.16.0. It matches Lloyd's k-means 25-epoch loss in just 1.4 to 2.6 epochs, achieving 10-45x GPU and 8-15x CPU speedups (self-reported). The method uses fitted scaling laws to set batch size and step size, eliminating hyperparameter tuning, and includes dead-cluster revival and fused GPU kernels. Tested on up to 10 billion points and 16.7 million clusters, e-means also avoids local minima better than Lloyd's algorithm.
summary_zh: Meta FAIR 发布了 e-means，一种使用指数移动平均（EMA）更新质心的小批量 k-means 算法，已集成在 FAISS 1.16.0 中。它仅需 1.4 到 2.6 个 epoch 就能达到 Lloyd's k-means 25 个 epoch 的损失，在 GPU 上实现 10-45 倍、CPU 上 8-15 倍的加速（自报告数据）。该方法通过拟合的缩放定律自动设置批量大小和步长，无需超参数调优，并包含死簇复活和融合 GPU 内核。在高达 100 亿个点和 1670 万个簇的数据上测试，e-means 也比 Lloyd 算法更能避免局部最优。

title_en: llm-gemini 0.36
title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 全面开放：性能、定价与创新应用
summary_en: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon, initially available to a subset of cyber defenders two weeks ago, is now publicly released. It is Google's best Gemini model, priced at $2/million input and $10/million output tokens at launch, but will double to $4/$20 on December 1st. The model excels in creative coding tasks, as demonstrated by generating a Three.js animation of a mech in New York City and an open-world 3D game using Google's Antigravity IDE with /swarm feature, coordinating subagents for 3D asset modeling, game development, and audio integration.
summary_zh: Google 的 Gemini 4 Carbon 在两周前仅向部分网络安全防御者开放，现已全面公开发布。这是 Google 迄今最好的 Gemini 模型，发布时定价为每百万输入 token 2 美元、每百万输出 token 10 美元，但将于 12 月 1 日翻倍至 4/20 美元。该模型在创意编码任务中表现出色，例如使用 Google Antigravity IDE 的 /swarm 功能生成 Three.js 动画和开放世界 3D 游戏，协调子代理进行 3D 资产建模、游戏开发和音频集成。

title_en: AutoScaffold: AI-Guided Scaffolding for Reinforcement Learning of Language Models
title_zh: AutoScaffold：AI引导的脚手架用于语言模型强化学习
summary_en: AutoScaffold is an AI-for-AI framework that converts a student model's training experience into adaptive scaffolds for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). A frozen teacher periodically examines the student's experience, diagnoses bottlenecks, and designs two types of scaffolds: shared strategies for task classes and hints for individual hard tasks, adjusting support as the student learns. Scaffolds are removed at evaluation. Applied to ALFWorld, search-based QA, mathematical reasoning, and GPU kernel generation, students trained with AutoScaffold outperform RL baselines without scaffolds, gaining 7.2 points in ALFWorld success, 4.0 points in average QA exact match, and up to 5.0 points in GPU kernel generation for tasks with correct kernels faster than PyTorch reference.
summary_zh: AutoScaffold 是一个 AI-for-AI 框架，可将学生模型的训练经验转化为自适应脚手架，用于带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）。一个冻结的教师模型定期检查学生经验、诊断瓶颈，并设计两种形式的脚手架：跨任务类别的共享策略和针对单个困难任务的提示，并根据学生学习进度调整支持内容和数量。评估时移除脚手架。在 ALFWorld、基于搜索的问答、数学推理和 GPU 内核生成四个领域应用后，无脚手架评估时，使用 AutoScaffold 训练的学生均优于相应 RL 基线：ALFWorld 成功率提升 7.2 分，问答平均精确匹配提升 4.0 分，GPU 内核生成中正确内核且运行快于 PyTorch 参考的任务比例最高提升 5.0 分。

title_en: Recurrent Modular Structure in Spiking Neural Network Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 脉冲神经网络强化学习中的循环模块化结构
summary_en: The paper introduces Community Recurrent Spiking Neural Networks (CoRe SNNs), a class of recurrent networks partitioned into fixed-role communities: a controller community receives stimuli, each action has its own community, and latent communities carry internal state. Spiking activity is a walk between communities, and the action is the community reached. All learning is local and three-factor. Three regimes for obtaining communities are compared: dynamic modularity with a new learning rule Map-STDP, partial modularity via stochastic block model initialization, and full modularity via sealing. On CartPole with three spiking neuron models, Map-STDP improves learning over the same network without it, matches full modularity on two of three models, and makes the spike walk more compressible. Replacing the feed-forward actor of a TD-STDP actor-critic with recurrent action communities improves performance.
summary_zh: 本文提出了社区循环脉冲神经网络（CoRe SNNs），这是一类划分为固定角色社区的循环网络：控制社区接收刺激，每个动作有各自的社区，潜在社区携带内部状态。脉冲活动是社区间的游走，动作是游走到达的社区。所有学习都是局部的三因子学习。比较了三种获得社区的方式：动态模块化（引入新学习规则Map-STDP在学习中鼓励模块结构）、部分模块化（通过随机块模型初始化部分强制）和完全模块化（通过密封完全强制）。在CartPole上，使用三种脉冲神经元模型，Map-STDP相比无此规则的相同网络提升了学习效果，在三种模型中的两种上匹配完全模块化（密封社区），并使观察到的脉冲游走更具可压缩性。将TD-STDP演员-评论家中的前馈演员替换为循环动作社区，性能优于前馈版本。

title_en: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available
title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 正式发布
summary_en: Google released Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest model for cybersecurity and long-horizon agentic workflows, ranking #1 on CursorBench 4.0, Perplexity's WANDR, and Zapier's AutomationBench at over 2X lower cost per task than the next best external model. Carbon achieves 100% recall and 95% precision on Project Fortify's internal scanning and triage benchmark, and 0% prompt injection attack success rate on the Gray Swan IPI benchmark. It is available via API at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, and to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Antigravity, Gemini app, and AI Mode in Search.
summary_zh: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Carbon，这是其在网络安全和长周期智能体工作流方面最强的模型，在 CursorBench 4.0、Perplexity 的 WANDR 和 Zapier 的 AutomationBench 上排名第一，每任务成本比次优外部模型低 2 倍以上。Carbon 在 Project Fortify 内部扫描和分类基准上达到 100% 召回率和 95% 精确率，在 Gray Swan IPI 基准上实现 0% 提示注入攻击成功率。该模型通过 API 提供，定价为每百万输入 token 2 美元、每百万输出 token 10 美元，并向 Google AI Ultra 订阅者开放 Antigravity、Gemini 应用和搜索 AI Mode。

title_en: Zyphra Releases ZONOS3-Mini: Open-Source TTS With 100M Active Parameters
title_zh: Zyphra 发布 ZONOS3-Mini：100M 激活参数的开源 TTS 模型
summary_en: Zyphra released ZONOS3-Mini, an open-source text-to-speech model with a sparse Mixture of Experts architecture (800M total, 100M active parameters) under Apache 2.0. It supports zero-shot voice cloning and word-level delivery control, and runs on browsers via WebGPU, NVIDIA GPUs via SGLang-Omni, Apple Silicon via MLX, and CPU/CUDA/Metal/Vulkan via ggml. On Zyphra's self-reported ZTTS2-Eval benchmark, it ranks first among open models with a Capability Index of 66.2, achieving 80 ms median time to first audio on one H100 at 8 concurrent requests. However, all benchmarks are self-reported, and reference-clip cloning scores much lower (44.7) than speaker-embedding mode.
summary_zh: Zyphra 发布了 ZONOS3-Mini，一个采用稀疏混合专家（MoE）架构的开源文本转语音模型，总参数 800M，激活参数约 100M，权重以 Apache 2.0 许可发布。该模型支持零样本语音克隆和词级表达控制，可通过 WebGPU 在浏览器中运行，也支持 NVIDIA GPU（SGLang-Omni）、Apple Silicon（MLX）以及 CPU/CUDA/Metal/Vulkan（ggml）等多种部署方式。在 Zyphra 自建的 ZTTS2-Eval 基准上，其能力指数为 66.2，在开源模型中排名第一；单张 H100 上 8 并发请求时首音频延迟中位数为 80 毫秒。但所有基准均由 Zyphra 自行运行，且参考音频克隆模式得分（44.7）远低于说话人嵌入模式。

title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2: Same Model, Different Safeguards
title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5.2 与 Mythos 5.2：同一模型，不同安全防护
summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, which are the same underlying frontier model with different safeguard levels. Fable 5.2 includes classifiers blocking high-risk cybersecurity and most research biology tasks, while Mythos 5.2 removes these blocks for verified users. The model features a 1M-token context window and 128K max output, and outperforms Opus 5.5 on most benchmarks, e.g., 49.1% on FrontierCode 2.0 and 69.9% on FrontierSWE v2, at roughly half the cost per task. It is available via hosted API only, priced at $8/$40 per million input/output tokens, with a 2.5x fast mode.
summary_zh: Anthropic 发布了 Claude Fable 5.2 和 Claude Mythos 5.2，二者是同一底层前沿模型，但安全防护级别不同。Fable 5.2 包含分类器，可阻止高风险网络安全任务和大多数研究生物学任务；Mythos 5.2 则移除了这些限制，仅对通过验证计划的用户开放。该模型具有 100 万 token 上下文窗口和 128K 最大输出，在大多数基准测试中超越 Opus 5.5，例如 FrontierCode 2.0 得分 49.1%，FrontierSWE v2 得分 69.9%，且每任务成本约为后者一半。仅通过托管 API 提供，定价为每百万输入/输出 token 8/40 美元，并提供 2.5 倍速快速模式。

title_en: Margin-Guided Token Credit for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
title_zh: 基于边际引导的令牌信用分配用于可验证奖励的强化学习
summary_en: The paper proposes MCPO (Margin-Credit Policy Optimization), a method for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards that redistributes token-level credit based on model hesitation, measured by the top-2 margin of the next-token distribution. Unlike GRPO, which assigns equal credit to all tokens, MCPO uses two fixed thresholds to map the margin to a score and spreads the advantage across tokens while preserving the mean. The method requires no extra model evaluation or batch statistics. Training MiniCPM5-2B-Base with LoRA for 200 steps on 2,048 DAPO-Math problems and evaluating on six competition-math benchmarks, MCPO outperforms GRPO by 6.55 points of macro avg@32 on average (95% CI [4.1, 9.0]) across five data seeds, with a Qwen3-4B-Base replication showing +4.75 points on all three seeds. Gains are largest on problems GRPO solves inconsistently and increase with k in pass@k, reaching 13.8 points at pass@32; MCPO models also produce two to three times longer answers, and longer answers correlate with higher scores, though the two effects are not separated.
summary_zh: 本文提出MCPO（Margin-Credit Policy Optimization），一种用于可验证奖励强化学习的方法，根据模型犹豫程度（通过下一令牌分布的前二边际衡量）重新分配令牌级信用。与GRPO对所有令牌等量分配奖励不同，MCPO使用两个固定阈值将边际映射为分数，并在保持均值不变的情况下将优势分散到各令牌上。该方法无需额外模型评估或批次统计。在2,048个DAPO-Math问题上使用LoRA训练MiniCPM5-2B-Base 200步，并在六个竞赛数学基准上评估，MCPO在五个数据种子上平均比GRPO基线高6.55个百分点的macro avg@32（95%置信区间[4.1, 9.0]），Qwen3-4B-Base复现实验在三个种子上均提升（+4.75）。增益在GRPO仅部分解决的问题上最大，并随pass@k中的k增长，在pass@32时达到13.8个百分点；MCPO模型生成的答案长度是原来的两到三倍，且答案更长的运行得分更高，但实验未区分这两种效应。

title_en: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
title_zh: AlphaProof Code 发布：深度验证复杂软件的重大突破
summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaProof Code, a multi-LLM agentic framework for formal verification that combines human expertise with AI agents. The framework was used to formally verify the security properties of the actual code underlying the Signal cryptographic protocol, marking the first time AI has been used to formally verify a widely deployed cryptographic protocol at this depth. The agents generated over six million lines of Lean proofs, and human experts only needed to review 1% of the codebase. The verification took just four weeks, a task that historically takes expert teams years. When two real bugs were reintroduced, the system produced machine-checked proofs that the buggy versions were insecure.
summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 AlphaProof Code，这是一个多 LLM 智能体框架，用于形式化验证，结合了人类专业知识和 AI 智能体。该框架被用于对 Signal 加密协议底层实际代码的安全属性进行形式化验证，这是首次使用 AI 对广泛部署的加密协议进行如此深度的形式化验证。智能体生成了超过六百万行 Lean 证明，人类专家仅需审查 1% 的代码库。验证过程仅耗时四周，而传统上专家团队需要数年时间。当重新引入两个真实漏洞时，系统生成了机器检查的证明，表明有漏洞的版本不安全。

title_en: TRUER: Test-Time Reward Correction Using an Error-Aware Rectifier for Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: TRUER：使用错误感知整流器进行测试时奖励校正的强化学习
summary_en: The paper introduces TRUER, a framework for test-time reinforcement learning that addresses the issue of majority voting reinforcing incorrect solutions. It trains a reward rectifier using a limited labeled source set, focusing on cases where consensus and correctness disagree (incorrect majorities and correct minorities). The rectifier is then frozen and used to correct rewards during test-time adaptation. TRUER consistently outperforms naive TTRL in both reward accuracy and model performance across all evaluated configurations.
summary_zh: 本文提出TRUER框架，用于测试时强化学习，解决多数投票可能强化错误解的问题。它利用有限的标注源集训练一个奖励整流器，重点关注共识与正确性不一致的情况（错误多数和正确少数）。随后冻结整流器，在测试时适应过程中校正奖励。在所有评估配置中，TRUER在奖励准确性和模型性能上均持续优于朴素TTRL。

title_en: Introducing Our Smallest, Most Efficient Model: Muse Ember
title_zh: Meta AI 推出最小高效模型 Muse Ember
summary_en: Meta AI released Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model for complex reasoning execution and repetitive agent tasks like tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, extraction, and long document parsing. It is priced at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens for shorter prompts, matching GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5, but with different long-prompt thresholds: Ember's price increases after 200k tokens, while Luna's after 272k and Haiku's after 100k. On the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index vs. Cost per Task chart, Muse Ember sits on the Pareto frontier, meaning no model scores higher for less cost per task. It offers six reasoning levels (minimal to max), and its output quality is comparable to Muse Wonder, which costs 40 times more.
summary_zh: Meta AI 发布了其最小、最高效的模型 Muse Ember，专为复杂推理执行和代理重复性任务（如工具调用、编码子任务、路由、提取和长文档解析）设计。对于较短提示，其定价为每百万输入 token 0.10 美元、每百万输出 token 0.50 美元，与 GPT-6 Luna 和 Claude Haiku 5.5 相同，但长提示阈值不同：Ember 在 20 万 token 后涨价，Luna 在 27.2 万后，Haiku 在 10 万后。在 Artificial Analysis 的智能指数与每任务成本图表上，Muse Ember 位于帕累托前沿，意味着没有模型能以更低成本获得更高分数。它提供六个推理级别（从 minimal 到 max），输出质量与价格为其 40 倍的 Muse Wonder 相当。

title_en: Meta Releases Muse Ember, a 1M-Context Model for High-Volume Agent Work
title_zh: Meta 发布 Muse Ember：面向高并发 Agent 任务的 100 万上下文模型
summary_en: Meta Superintelligence Labs released Muse Ember, a hosted multimodal reasoning model for high-volume agent subtasks like tool calls, coding, routing, and long document parsing. It features a 1M-token context window and up to 512K output tokens, accepts text, images, audio, and video, and is the first model trained using Meta's largest model, Muse Wonder Full. On the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, it scores 36, tying Claude Haiku 5.5 at max effort, while costing about $0.136 per task versus Haiku's $0.411. It excels on agent benchmarks (37.8 on AutomationBench-AA) but lags on mergeable code (27.2 on FrontierCode 2.0-AA).
summary_zh: Meta Superintelligence Labs 发布了 Muse Ember，这是一个托管的多模态推理模型，专为高并发 Agent 子任务（如工具调用、编码、路由和长文档解析）设计。它支持 100 万 token 上下文窗口和最多 512K 输出 token，可原生处理文本、图像、音频和视频，并且是首个使用 Meta 最大模型 Muse Wonder Full 训练而成的模型。在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数上，它以最大推理努力得分 36，与 Claude Haiku 5.5 持平，但每任务成本约为 0.136 美元，而 Haiku 为 0.411 美元。它在 Agent 基准测试中表现突出（AutomationBench-AA 得分 37.8），但在可合并代码任务上落后（FrontierCode 2.0-AA 得分 27.2）。

title_en: Closing the BF16-FP16 Convergence Speed Gap in RL Post-Training with Stochastic Rounding
title_zh: 通过随机舍入缩小RL后训练中BF16与FP16的收敛速度差距
summary_en: The article identifies that in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), BF16 mixed-precision training converges more slowly than FP16 at the same learning rate due to "weight sticking": small updates to FP32 shadow weights often leave BF16 weights unchanged after round-to-nearest quantization. Raising the BF16 learning rate can match FP16's convergence speed but increases KL divergence from the reference model. The authors propose applying stochastic rounding when quantizing FP32 shadow weights to BF16, which matches FP16's convergence speed across models and datasets while reducing KL divergence compared to BF16 with a larger learning rate, and retains BF16's wider dynamic range without needing loss scaling.
summary_zh: 文章指出，在带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，相同学习率下BF16混合精度训练比FP16收敛更慢，原因是“权重粘滞”：FP32影子权重经最近舍入量化为BF16时，微小更新常无法改变BF16权重。提高BF16学习率可匹配FP16收敛速度，但会增大与参考模型的KL散度。作者提出在将FP32影子权重量化为BF16时采用随机舍入，从而在不同模型和数据集上匹配FP16的收敛速度，同时相比使用更大学习率的BF16训练降低KL散度，并保留BF16更宽的动态范围且无需损失缩放。

title_en: llm-anthropic 0.31
title_zh: llm-anthropic 0.31 版本更新：支持 Anthropic Fable 5.2 与 Mythos 5.2 模型
summary_en: Anthropic released Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, with Fable 5.2 currently ranked first on Artificial Analysis. The llm-anthropic plugin version 0.31 adds support for these models, allowing prompts to be run via the llm CLI. Testing across five reasoning levels (low, medium, high, xhigh, max) revealed that the max level failed to return an image due to running out of tokens after 128,000 thinking tokens, a bug also seen in Opus 5.5 but new to the Fable series. Pricing is $8/million input and $40/million output, a 20% discount from Fable 5.1's $10/$50.
summary_zh: Anthropic 发布了 Fable 5.2 和 Mythos 5.2，其中 Fable 5.2 目前在 Artificial Analysis 上排名第一。llm-anthropic 插件 0.31 版本新增了对这些模型的支持，可通过 llm 命令行工具运行提示。在五个推理级别（low、medium、high、xhigh、max）的测试中，max 级别因在 128,000 个思考 token 后耗尽 token 而未能返回图像，该问题在 Opus 5.5 中也曾出现，但对 Fable 系列是新问题。定价为每百万输入 token 8 美元、输出 token 40 美元，较 Fable 5.1 的 10/50 美元打了 20% 折扣。

title_en: Enforcing Axioms for AI Alignment under Loss-Based Rules
title_zh: 基于损失规则的AI对齐中公理约束的实施
summary_en: The paper investigates whether Pareto optimality (PO) can be recovered in loss-based reward model training for AI alignment, where principles act as voters represented as linear directions in an embedding space. It shows that PO can fail for polynomial reward models of any fixed degree and one-hidden-layer ReLU MLPs of any fixed width d≥2 with finite parameter bounds. However, PO can be recovered for linear rewards under suitable assumptions in an idealized setting with uniform comparison directions and equal comparison lengths. These results suggest dataset design as a way to enforce PO in constitutional-style alignment while retaining loss-based training.
summary_zh: 本文研究在基于损失训练的奖励模型中能否恢复帕累托最优性（PO），其中原则作为投票者表示为嵌入空间中的线性方向。研究表明，对于任意固定次数的多项式奖励模型和任意固定宽度 d≥2 的单隐藏层 ReLU 多层感知机（MLP），在有限参数界下 PO 仍可能失效。然而，在理想化设置中，当比较方向均匀且比较长度相等时，线性奖励的基于损失训练可以恢复 PO。这些结果启发了通过数据集设计在宪法式对齐中实施 PO，同时保留基于损失的训练。

title_en: Wrong the Same Way: Cross-Prompt Sharing Both Suppresses and Amplifies Reward Hacking in RLVR
title_zh: 同样的错误：跨提示共享在RLVR中既抑制又放大奖励黑客行为
summary_en: The paper studies how reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) interacts with an imperfect verifier, specifically whether reward hacking is inherited from the base model or amplified by RL. Using a controlled environment where the entire response distribution can be computed exactly, the authors vary the universality of a leak (fraction of prompts accepting the same wrong response) and the verifier's false-positive rate. They find that at the KL-regularized optimum, RLVR acts as a filter that reweights the accepted set without altering its composition, so the hack rate is inherited exactly. With parameter sharing, prompts that accept a wrong answer push it up and those that reject it push it down, leading to suppression of low-universality leaks and amplification of high-universality leaks. This effect is consistent across Adam, SGD, and sampled GRPO, though whether the hack rate crosses the base rate depends on step size; independent per-prompt copies remove the dependence.
summary_zh: 本文研究了带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）与不完美验证器交互的两种观点：奖励黑客行为是从基模型继承的还是被RL放大的。在一个可以精确计算整个响应分布的小型受控环境中，作者变化泄漏的普遍性（接受相同错误响应的提示比例）和验证器的静态假阳性率。发现在KL正则化最优下，RLVR充当过滤器，对接受集重新加权而不改变其组成，因此黑客率被精确继承。在参数共享下，接受错误答案的提示会通过基线将其概率推高，拒绝的提示则将其推低，导致低普遍性泄漏被抑制到基率以下，而高普遍性泄漏被放大。在Adam、SGD和采样的GRPO下，高普遍性时的黑客率最终高于低普遍性时，但两端是否跨越基率取决于步长；独立的每提示副本消除了这种依赖。

title_en: Building World Models from Intrinsic Motivation
title_zh: 从内在动机构建世界模型
summary_en: This study integrates 24 intrinsic objectives (curiosity, entropy, competency) into a model-based RL framework to learn world models without extrinsic rewards. Using three representation-learning strategies (observation reconstruction, latent prediction, redundancy reduction), they evaluate zero-shot, few-shot, and multi-task control in locomotion, manipulation, and open-ended games. Curiosity-driven exploration with observation reconstruction yields the strongest aggregate profile, though the best individual pairing is task-dependent. In compositional vision tasks, intrinsic motivation from episodic and lifelong novelty—complementing the world model's recurrent state—achieves the best zero-shot transfer and few-shot performance.
summary_zh: 本研究将24种内在动机目标（好奇心、熵、能力）集成到基于模型的强化学习框架中，以在无外部奖励下学习世界模型。采用三种表示学习策略（观测重建、潜在预测、冗余减少），在运动、操作和开放式游戏中评估零样本、少样本和多任务控制。好奇心驱动探索结合观测重建获得最强的综合表现，但最佳个体组合取决于任务。在组合视觉任务中，来自情景和终身新颖性的内在动机——作为世界模型通用循环状态的补充记忆——实现了最佳的零样本迁移和少样本性能。

title_en: Anthropic launches new Claude Fable and Mythos 5.2 models
title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5.2 与 Mythos 5.2 模型
summary_en: Anthropic announced two new models, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, claiming improvements in coding, reasoning, and vision, and faster output generation than their 5.1 predecessors. Fable 5.2 is designed for challenging software engineering, can orchestrate agent teams, and tackle long-running projects; during prerelease testing, the models helped complete otherwise-infeasible software migrations, designed three working electronic devices from scratch, solved two open problems in black hole physics, made substantial progress on robotics evaluations, and formalized the proof of Fermat's Last Theorem in 30 hours. Fable 5.2 is available today, while Mythos 5.2 is initially restricted to vetted organizations. The 5.2 models follow the September release of Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1.
summary_zh: Anthropic 发布两款新模型 Claude Fable 5.2 和 Claude Mythos 5.2，宣称在编码、推理和视觉方面有所提升，且输出速度比 5.1 版本更快。Fable 5.2 擅长解决具有挑战性的软件工程问题，能协调智能体团队并处理长期项目；在预发布测试中，这些模型帮助完成了原本不可行的软件迁移、从零设计了三款可工作的电子设备、解决了黑洞物理中的两个开放问题、在机器人评估上取得实质性进展，并在 30 小时内形式化了费马大定理的证明。Fable 5.2 今日起可用，而 Mythos 5.2 初期仅限经过审核的组织使用。5.2 模型紧随 9 月发布的 Fable 5.1 和 Mythos 5.1 之后推出。

title_en: MaxIM: Maximally Informative Incremental Summarization via Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: MaxIM: 通过强化学习实现最大化信息量的增量摘要
summary_en: MaxIM (Maximally Informative Incremental Memory) is a framework that formulates incremental summarization as a capacity-constrained, information-theoretic reward-shaping problem. It addresses credit assignment bottlenecks in standard RL by deriving a variational lower bound on predictive sufficiency and introducing a recursive consistency condition to ensure summaries are grounded via mutual information maximization. A parameterized asymmetric critic computes step-wise variational MI bounds for dense reward shaping. Empirical results on long-horizon scientific reading and multi-turn dialogue benchmarks show MaxIM outperforms RL, supervised fine-tuning, and prompt-focused baselines on factual grounding, comprehensive autorater metrics, and downstream task utility under strict token budgets and extended horizons, without expensive human preference labels.
summary_zh: MaxIM（最大化信息量增量记忆）是一个将增量摘要形式化为容量受限的信息论奖励塑造问题的框架。它通过推导预测充分性的变分下界并引入递归一致性条件，确保摘要通过最大化与观察历史的互信息（MI）来扎根，从而解决标准强化学习（RL）中的信用分配瓶颈。参数化的非对称评论家计算逐步变分MI下界以进行密集奖励塑造。在长视野科学阅读和多轮对话基准上的实证评估表明，MaxIM在事实扎根、综合自动评分指标和下游任务效用上优于RL、监督微调和提示聚焦基线，且在严格令牌预算和扩展视野下无需昂贵的人类偏好标签。

title_en: Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks
title_zh: Agentic-OPD：通过在线策略蒸馏恢复智能体任务中遗忘的智能体能力
summary_en: The paper shows that standard GRPO training of LLM agents discards checkpoints that collectively solve more problems than the best-validation checkpoint alone. These discarded checkpoints form a free teacher pool that on-policy distillation (OPD) can mine to recover lost coverage. Agentic-OPD treats the best-validation checkpoint as the student and all saved checkpoints as frozen teachers, using the student's evolving capability gaps to guide teacher selection (HCN, Highest Coverage Next, which picks teachers by weighted coverage of the student's unsolved problems) and supervision filtering (LAD, Locality-Aware Distillation, which restricts transfer to failed student rollouts on problems where the teacher performs better). Experiments span five agentic task domains and 24 benchmarks.
summary_zh: 论文指出，在 LLM 智能体的标准 GRPO 训练中，仅保留最佳验证检查点会丢弃其他检查点，而后者合起来解决的问题远超单一最佳检查点，因此这些被丢弃的检查点构成了无需额外训练成本的教师池，可借助在线策略蒸馏（OPD）挖掘以恢复丢失的覆盖能力。Agentic-OPD 将最佳验证检查点作为学生模型、所有已保存检查点作为冻结教师候选，利用学生不断变化的能力缺口同时指导教师选择与监督过滤：HCN（Highest Coverage Next）策略按对学生未解决问题的加权覆盖率动态选择教师，LAD（Locality-Aware Distillation）模块将迁移限制在学生失败且教师表现更好的问题的 rollout 上。实验覆盖五个智能体任务领域和 24 个基准与任务。

title_en: Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Clinical Agents: When Dense Rewards Beat Outcome Rewards
title_zh: 安全强化学习用于多轮临床智能体：密集奖励何时优于结果奖励
summary_en: The paper studies reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for multi-turn clinical agents that must decide what information to request, when to stop, and which action to take. It introduces three controlled environments: medication refill triage, acute diagnostic work-up, and dosing titration, each with hidden states, query costs, and deterministic verifiers. Outcome-only group relative policy optimization often improves aggregate reward but causes undesirable procedures like premature commitment and one-question collapse, and fails on rare high-risk cases. In diagnostics, dense credit for uncertainty-reducing questions improves held-out value and moderate-case support across three seeds without high-risk collapse, while separating exploration from exploitation further increases high-risk support at the cost of excessive information gathering on low-acuity cases. Optimal process credit strength is task-dependent, and after supervised warmup, RL raises aggregate reward by trimming questions but degrades high-risk performance.
summary_zh: 本文研究了基于可验证奖励的强化学习在多轮临床智能体中的应用，这些智能体需决定请求哪些信息、何时停止收集证据以及采取何种行动。作者引入了三个受控环境：药物续方分诊、急性诊断检查和剂量滴定，每个环境均包含隐藏临床状态、查询成本、精确自适应预言机和确定性结果验证器。仅使用结果奖励的组相对策略优化（GRPO）通常能提升总体奖励，但会产生不良流程，如过早承诺、单问题崩溃以及在罕见高风险病例上失败。在诊断任务中，对降低不确定性的问题分配密集信用，相比仅结果强化学习，在三个训练种子下均提升了留出价值和中等病例支持度，且未出现仅结果训练中的高风险种子崩溃。将探索与利用分离进一步提升了最佳检查点的高风险支持度，但代价是在低 acuity 病例上过度收集信息。额外实验表明，过程信用的最优强度取决于任务；在已进行谨慎信息收集的监督预热后，强化学习通过削减问题提升总体奖励，但会降低高风险性能。

title_en: Simulation-aided Reinforcement Learning with Control Variates
title_zh: 基于控制变量的模拟辅助强化学习
summary_en: The paper addresses the problem of using simulators to augment real-world data in reinforcement learning, where naive mixing can degrade performance due to simulator bias. It proposes a conservative simulation-aided learning method based on control variates, where simulated data is used only to reduce variance without directly shaping the learning target. The approach is developed for policy evaluation, integrated into an actor-critic framework for policy improvement, and extended to offline RL. Experiments on MuJoCo benchmarks show improvements over standard simulation mixing approaches.
summary_zh: 本文针对强化学习中使用模拟器增强真实数据时，因模拟器偏差导致性能下降的问题，提出了一种基于控制变量（control variates）的保守模拟辅助学习方法。该方法仅利用模拟数据降低学习过程中的方差，而不直接塑造学习目标。作者首先在策略评估中开发了该方法，然后将其集成到演员-评论家（actor-critic）框架中以实现策略改进，并扩展到离线强化学习场景。在多个 MuJoCo 基准任务上的实验表明，该方法优于标准的模拟混合方法。

title_en: AgentOPSD: Turn-Level Credit Assignment via Recursive Belief Revision
title_zh: AgentOPSD：通过递归信念修正的回合级信用分配
summary_en: AgentOPSD introduces a critic-free reinforcement learning scheme that assigns credit recursively at each interaction turn, addressing the coarse granularity of trajectory-level advantage in multi-turn tasks. Within a turn, token-level log-probability gaps between a skill-conditioned self-teacher and the student are summed and used as evidence in a recursive Bayesian update in log-odds space, producing bounded, sign-preserving multipliers that reallocate outcome-derived advantage across turns. On ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B backbones, it consistently outperforms GRPO and self-distillation baselines, achieving 89.1% success at 7B scale. Ablations show gains stem from aggregating evidence at turn boundaries and history-dependent belief revision, not from local gaps alone.
summary_zh: AgentOPSD 提出一种无评论家的强化学习方案，在每个交互回合递归地分配信用，解决了多轮任务中轨迹级优势粒度过粗的问题。在每个回合内，将技能条件自教师与学生之间的 token 级对数概率差求和，作为证据在 log-odds 空间中进行递归贝叶斯更新，产生有界且保持符号的乘数，从而将结果衍生的优势重新分配到各回合。在 ALFWorld 上使用 Qwen2.5-3B 和 Qwen2.5-7B 作为策略骨干，该方法持续优于 GRPO 和自蒸馏基线，在 7B 规模达到 89.1% 的成功率。消融实验表明增益来自回合边界处的证据聚合以及依赖历史的信念修正，而非局部差距本身。

title_en: RAIL: Representation-Aligned Imitation Learning for Student-Compatible Teacher Policies
title_zh: RAIL：面向学生兼容教师策略的表示对齐模仿学习
summary_en: Reinforcement learning from raw sensory inputs is challenging due to high-dimensional observations and sparse rewards. A common approach is to train a teacher policy with privileged state information and distill it into a student policy that acts from raw inputs, but this creates an irreducible imitation gap when the teacher relies on unavailable information. The authors introduce Representation-Aligned Imitation Learning (RAIL), which learns a shared latent representation across teacher and student observations using contrastive learning and trains the teacher policy directly in this space, constraining it to behaviors reproducible from student observations. RAIL substantially reduces the imitation gap while preserving task performance, outperforms strong baselines without reward modification or post-hoc student fine-tuning, and surpasses direct reinforcement learning from raw observations. The learned representations also enable zero-shot transfer to new tasks through teacher-only training.
summary_zh: 从原始感官输入（如图像或车载传感器）进行强化学习（RL）面临高维观测和稀疏奖励的挑战。常见策略是先训练一个能访问特权状态信息的教师策略，再将其蒸馏为仅从原始输入行动的学生策略。然而，当教师依赖学生不可用的信息时，精确模仿可能无法实现，产生不可消除的模仿差距。现有方法通常通过仔细的奖励塑造或教师训练后对学生策略进行额外强化学习来缓解这种不匹配。为此，作者提出表示对齐模仿学习（RAIL），在教师训练本身解决该不匹配问题。RAIL 使用对比学习学习教师和学生观测共享的潜在表示，并直接在该空间中训练教师策略。由于教师策略被约束在该共享空间上操作，它学习的行为可从学生观测中复现，从而在保持任务性能的同时大幅减少模仿差距。在多个环境中，RAIL 无需修改奖励或事后微调学生，即优于强基线，并超越直接从原始观测进行强化学习。学习到的表示还通过仅教师训练实现了对新任务的零样本迁移。

title_en: SkillDuet: Co-Evolving Models and Skills through Response Feedback
title_zh: SkillDuet：通过响应反馈实现模型与技能协同进化
summary_en: SkillDuet is a framework that coordinates parameter updates and skill evolution in LLMs through response feedback. Skills extracted from on-policy trajectories guide parameter updates via OPD at every step. A response-based score called Strength ranks candidate skills by the magnitude of shift they induce in the current model's responses, and top-scoring skills are periodically consolidated into a persistent global skill set (Global). The updated model and Global jointly guide subsequent interactions, generating experience for further updates. With Qwen3-4B, SkillDuet achieves 98.57% success rate on ALFWorld and 92.97% on WebShop, outperforming the SEED-API baseline by 2.86 and 5.47 percentage points, respectively.
summary_zh: SkillDuet 是一个通过响应反馈协调参数更新与技能进化的框架。从在线策略轨迹中提取的技能通过 OPD 在每一步指导参数更新。基于响应的评分 Strength 根据技能对当前模型响应引起的偏移幅度对候选技能进行排序，得分最高的技能定期整合到持久的全局技能集（Global）中。更新后的模型与 Global 共同指导后续交互，生成用于进一步参数和技能更新的经验。在 Qwen3-4B 上，SkillDuet 在 ALFWorld 上达到 98.57% 的成功率，在 WebShop 上达到 92.97%，分别超过匹配的 SEED-API 基线 2.86 和 5.47 个百分点。

title_en: Zero-Search Reinforcement Learning for Slay the Spire 2 with Failure-Driven Restarts
title_zh: Slay the Spire 2 零搜索强化学习：基于失败驱动的重启训练
summary_en: This work trains agents for Slay the Spire 2 (STS2) using a 6.6M-parameter entity transformer that selects every action in a single forward pass without lookahead or search. Training and evaluation run the game's compiled assembly (v0.107.1) in a headless .NET host that deterministically replays runs from seed and actions, enabling a failure-driven curriculum that restarts episodes from visited states in proportion to where full runs are lost. On 12,800 held-out Ascension 10 games, released policies win 8.05% averaged across five characters (Ironclad 15.6%, Regent 12.5%), versus 0.55% for AlphaSpire's search-free networks; longer training raised Ironclad from 12.4% to 15.6% and Defect from 3.0% to 8.1%. At Ascension 0 the policies win 80.2%, matching Spire Mentor's reported 80.3%, though Mentor leads by 5-8 points from A4 upward and edges out 8.8% vs 8.2% on 2,000 A10 games while our policies need 21-27 ms per decision on one CPU core. GPT-6 Astra at maximum reasoning won none of 11 A10 games through the text interface.
summary_zh: 该工作为《Slay the Spire 2》(STS2) 训练智能体，使用 6.6M 参数的实体 transformer，每次决策仅需一次前向传播，不做前瞻或搜索。训练与评估在无头 .NET 宿主中运行游戏编译程序集 (v0.107.1)，宿主可依据种子与动作精确重放对局，从而支持失败驱动的课程学习：按完整对局失败位置的比例从已访问状态重启训练回合。在 12,800 局留出的 Ascension 10 (A10) 对局上，发布策略在五个角色上平均胜率 8.05%（Ironclad 15.6%，Regent 12.5%），而 AlphaSpire 无搜索网络仅 0.55%；延长 A10 训练使 Ironclad 从 12.4% 提升至 15.6%，Defect 从 3.0% 提升至 8.1%。在 Ascension 0 下策略胜率 80.2%，与树搜索智能体 Spire Mentor 报告的 80.3% 持平，但 Mentor 从 A4 起领先 5-8 个百分点，并在同一 2,000 局 A10 对局中以 8.8% 对 8.2% 略胜，而本策略单 CPU 核心每次决策需 21-27 ms。GPT-6 Astra 在最大推理下通过文本接口在 11 局 A10 对局中一局未胜。

title_en: FireGate: Bounding Behaviour Change Before Training in Continual RL Fine-Tuning
title_zh: FireGate：在持续强化学习微调中于训练前限定行为变化
summary_en: FireGate bounds behavior change before training in continual reinforcement learning fine-tuning. It places each task's update (e.g., a new LoRA) behind a gate—a classifier on frozen lower layers—that decides per prompt whether to apply the update. On any prompt distribution, bounded behavior scores change by at most the gate's firing rate, calibrated on unlabeled prompts with a PAC guarantee. On RL streams of up to five tasks, gated training changes only 3.3% of held-out chat responses versus 91.8% for ungated training, while retaining earlier tasks.
summary_zh: FireGate 在持续强化学习微调中于训练前限定行为变化。它将每个任务的更新（如新的 LoRA）置于一个门控之后，该门控是基于模型冻结低层分类器的，对每个提示决定是否应用更新。在任何提示分布上，有界行为分数的变化至多等于门控的触发率，该触发率在未标记提示上校准并提供 PAC 保证。在多达五个任务的强化学习流上，门控训练仅改变 3.3% 的保留聊天响应，而无门控训练改变 91.8%，同时保留先前任务。

title_en: Constrained Variational Policy Optimization for Hybrid Action Spaces
title_zh: 混合动作空间的约束变分策略优化
summary_en: The paper introduces Hybrid Constrained Variational Policy Optimization (H-CVPO), extending the constrained variational policy optimization framework to hybrid action spaces. Under boundedness and strict feasibility, the constrained E-step has zero duality gap and yields a closed-form joint target distribution via exponential reward-cost reweighting when the dual optimum is at positive temperature. Using exact hybrid KL decomposition, a factorized M-step fits both discrete and conditional-continuous policy components under separate trust regions. Theoretical results include fixed-reference surrogate improvement and conditional reward-cost bounds for exact updates, and existence of a dual minimizer for approximate updates. Ablations show cost-aware reweighting is crucial for constraint control.
summary_zh: 本文提出了混合约束变分策略优化（H-CVPO），将约束变分策略优化框架扩展到混合动作空间。在有界性和严格可行性下，约束E步具有零对偶间隙，并且当对偶最优在正温度下达到时，通过指数奖励-成本重加权得到混合动作上的闭式联合目标分布。利用精确的混合KL分解，因子化M步在分离的离散和条件连续信任区域下拟合两个策略组件。对于精确更新，证明了固定参考代理改进和条件奖励-成本界；对于近似更新，建立了对偶最小化子的存在性。消融实验表明成本感知重加权对约束控制至关重要。

title_en: An Evaluation of Tabular Foundation Models as Training-Free World Models
title_zh: 表格基础模型作为免训练世界模型的评估
summary_en: This paper evaluates whether a pretrained tabular foundation model (TabFM) can serve as a training-free dynamics model for world modeling by framing next-state prediction as in-context regression over transition pairs. Across synthetic dynamical systems and robot locomotion benchmarks, TabFM outperforms LSTM and MLP models trained from scratch on limited transitions in almost all settings, and is the most accurate among regressors fitted to the same data on locomotion, though a Gaussian process is better on smooth low-dimensional systems. However, models trained on the full dataset remain substantially better on most systems. In autoregressive rollouts, TabFM's accuracy depends strongly on context length: short context degrades to a trivial baseline, while long context improves substantially and even exceeds a trained LSTM on one locomotion task. Inference is about three orders of magnitude slower than an LSTM, leading to the conclusion that training-free priors are useful when data are scarce and enough context is available, but are not yet a substitute for trained world models.
summary_zh: 本文评估了预训练表格基础模型（TabFM）能否作为免训练的动力学模型用于世界建模，方法是将下一状态预测构建为基于转移对的上下文回归。在合成动力系统和机器人运动基准上，TabFM在几乎所有设置中都比从零训练的LSTM和MLP模型更准确（使用相同的有限转移数据），并且在拟合相同数据的回归器中，在运动任务上最准确，但在平滑低维系统上高斯过程更优。然而，在大多数系统上，使用完整数据集训练的模型仍然明显更好。在自回归多步展开中，TabFM的准确性强烈依赖于上下文长度：短上下文时其展开迅速退化到平凡基线的水平，而长上下文时则显著提升，并在一个运动任务上超过了训练的LSTM。推理速度也比LSTM慢约三个数量级。总体而言，当前状态下，免训练先验在数据稀缺且上下文充足时是有用的预测器，但尚不能替代训练好的世界模型。

title_en: Can Hindsight Critics Guide Delayed Actors?
title_zh: Hindsight Critics 能否指导延迟行动者？
summary_en: The paper investigates whether temporal misalignments caused by sensory delays in reinforcement learning can be mitigated during training using hindsight to recover aligned state-action transitions. It introduces Hindsight Critics, an asymmetric extension of Soft Actor-Critic for partially observable settings, where critics are trained on hindsight-aligned transitions while the actor learns from privileged value estimates despite only having delayed observations. Experiments on the DelayBench suite show that Hindsight Critics can partially compensate for observation delays without modifying the agent's observations during deployment, outperforming delay-aware and unaware baselines.
summary_zh: 本文探讨在强化学习中，能否通过利用事后信息恢复对齐的状态-动作转移，来缓解由感官延迟引起的时间错位问题。作者提出了 Hindsight Critics，这是 Soft Actor-Critic 在部分可观测条件下的非对称扩展：critics 在事后对齐的转移上训练，而 actor 则从由此产生的特权价值估计中学习，尽管它只能访问延迟的观测。在 DelayBench 测试集上的实验表明，Hindsight Critics 能够部分补偿观测延迟，且无需在部署时修改智能体的观测，优于延迟感知和延迟无感知的基线方法。

title_en: Spectral Rank and Step-Direction Dynamics in Language-Model Post-Training
title_zh: 语言模型后训练中的谱秩与步方向动力学
summary_en: The paper reconciles conflicting observations about weight updates in language-model post-training: nearly full-rank updates versus low stable-rank changes. For singular values decaying as σ_i ∝ i^{-α} with 0 < α ≤ 1/2, it proves that stable rank becomes negligible relative to fixed-energy rank as dimension grows. Full SVDs of OLMo-2-7B updates confirm this: three PPO attention updates have stable ranks of 9.6–18.3 but require 532–1,222 singular components to capture 80% of energy. Consecutive checkpoint-displacement cosines from full-model inner products show all 131 adjacent pairs across nine RLVR stages have negative cosines on native checkpoint grids, including PPO and GRPO trajectories. Supervised fine-tuning comparisons across four model families show configuration-dependent alignment, including negative late-training cosines for Mistral and FP32 Llama. A controlled OLMo-2-1B study with three paired seeds and a 2,048-token response cap compares group-relative advantages against a learned critic with GAE, finding at matched 60-rollout windows that late-training metrics differ.
summary_zh: 该论文调和了语言模型后训练中权重更新的矛盾观察：近乎满秩的更新与低稳定秩变化。对于奇异值按 σ_i ∝ i^{-α}（0 < α ≤ 1/2）衰减的情况，证明随着维度增加，稳定秩相对于固定能量秩变得可忽略。对OLMo-2-7B更新的完整奇异值分解证实了这种分离：三个PPO注意力更新的稳定秩为9.6–18.3，但需要532–1,222个奇异分量才能捕获80%的能量。通过全模型内积计算连续检查点位移余弦，发现在九个RLVR阶段的全部131个相邻对在其原生检查点网格上均具有负余弦，包括PPO和GRPO轨迹。四个模型家族的监督微调比较显示配置相关的对齐，包括Mistral和FP32 Llama在训练后期的负余弦。一项受控的OLMo-2-1B研究使用三个配对种子和2,048个token的响应上限，比较了组相对优势与使用GAE的学习评论家，发现在匹配的60次rollout窗口下，训练后期的指标存在差异。

title_en: Thinking Machines Releases Inkling 2 Small, a 594B MoE With 17B Active
title_zh: Thinking Machines 发布 Inkling 2 Small：594B MoE 模型，激活参数 17B
summary_en: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling 2 Small, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 594B total and 17B active parameters, supporting text and image input with variable reasoning effort. It uses a 48-layer decoder-only transformer routing each token to 8 of 384 experts, a 292M-parameter vision encoder, and 1M-token context. Pretraining ran in four phases totaling over 12T tokens, followed by a joint RL run of 1,075 steps and 17M+ rollouts on 2,048 GPUs. It scores 31 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (up from 13 for Inkling Small), achieves 86.3% on SWE-Bench Pro v2 (Hard), but only 13.1% on Terminal-Bench 4.0. The model is available on Tinker for fine-tuning and inference, with Apache 2.0 weights planned after safety testing.
summary_zh: Thinking Machines Lab 发布了 Inkling 2 Small，这是一个稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型，总参数 594B，激活参数 17B，支持文本和图像输入，并支持可变推理努力。它采用 48 层仅解码器 Transformer，每个 token 路由到 384 个专家中的 8 个，配备 292M 参数的视觉编码器，上下文长度 1M token。预训练分四个阶段，总计超过 12T token，随后在 2,048 块 GPU 上进行联合强化学习（RL），共 1,075 步、超过 1700 万次 rollout。在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数上得分为 31（前代 Inkling Small 为 13），在 SWE-Bench Pro v2（Hard）上达到 86.3%，但在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上仅 13.1%。该模型已在 Tinker 上提供微调和推理，计划在安全测试后以 Apache 2.0 许可证开放权重。

title_en: Unpacking the Compute Efficiency of Strong-to-Weak OPD against GRPO
title_zh: 解析强到弱OPD与GRPO的计算效率对比
summary_en: This paper systematically compares on-policy distillation (OPD) with reverse-KL against Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) in terms of held-out accuracy per training FLOP across task difficulty, model sizes, domains, and optimization choices. With an external post-trained teacher, OPD generally underperforms GRPO at matched settings and often causes response-length inflation. However, when the teacher is the student's own GRPO checkpoint, OPD recovers that checkpoint's math accuracy with 50x fewer distillation FLOPs than GRPO requires. This efficiency holds for a larger student, on code, and in a second model family. Multi-teacher OPD consolidates per-domain GRPO experts into a single student matching each expert's accuracy, with distillation costing only 5.2% (2 domains) and 8.0% (more domains) of total compute.
summary_zh: 本文系统比较了基于反向KL的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）与组相对策略优化（GRPO）在任务难度、学生与教师规模、领域及优化选择等维度下，以训练FLOPs衡量的留出准确率。当教师为外部后训练模型时，OPD在同等设置下通常不如GRPO，且常出现回复长度膨胀。但当教师为学生自身的GRPO检查点时，OPD在数学任务上以比GRPO少50倍的蒸馏FLOPs恢复该检查点的准确率，该高效性在更大规模学生、代码任务及第二个模型家族中均成立。多教师OPD可将各领域GRPO专家整合为单一学生，匹配各专家准确率，蒸馏阶段仅占总计算量的5.2%（2个领域）和8.0%（更多领域）。

title_en: AttnSR: Attention Step Reward for Long-Horizon Agentic RL
title_zh: AttnSR：面向长程智能体强化学习的注意力步骤奖励
summary_en: AttnSR is a step-level reward augmentation method for long-horizon LLM agents that derives reward allocations from policy attention during training replay, eliminating the need for a separate reward model or extra rollouts. It traces backward through the policy model's attention graph to estimate the relevance of earlier steps to the final response, with the terminal step (relative to a running baseline) determining whether rewards reinforce or penalize selected steps. In a Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct study on ALFWorld, AttnSR raised final held-out success from 91.2% to 97.1% over PPO, and ablation shows the benefit depends on reward assignment rather than simple accumulation. AttnSR also improved ScienceWorld at every checkpoint while cutting environment interactions by 29.9%.
summary_zh: AttnSR 是一种面向长程 LLM 智能体的步骤级奖励增强方法，它从训练回放中提取的策略注意力来分配奖励，无需单独训练奖励模型或额外 rollout。该方法通过反向追踪策略模型的注意力图来估计早期步骤与最终响应的相关性，并以终端步骤（相对于运行基线）决定这些奖励是强化还是惩罚所选步骤。在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的受控研究中，AttnSR 在 ALFWorld 上所有评估检查点均优于 PPO 基线，将最终留出成功率从 91.2% 提升至 97.1%；消融实验表明收益取决于中间奖励的分配方式，而非步骤奖励的简单累积。AttnSR 在 ScienceWorld 的每个检查点也有提升，同时将环境交互减少 29.9%。
